display.purpose: Page and panel titles; serif, Cloister Black blackletter in Evil.

narrative.overview: A status bar, a project dock, and pages that say who is live, what they are doing, and what the operator can do next. Serif titles, sans instrument body, mono data, colour only for meaning.
keyCharacteristics: Agent identity as provider marks, titled by role and model

rules.name: The Signal Rule
rules.body: The accent is reserved for selection, focus, links, and primary actions.

rules.name: Never Colour Alone
rules.body: Every status and harness colour ships with a text label.

dos: Keep the broker pill and project context visible on every page
Use real counts and timestamps from connected stores
Show why a control is disabled
donts: Use the accent on inactive states
Use gradients, glass, or terminal tropes
Reuse a status colour as a harness colour
